metadata.description: A Unique name used for the Virtual Machine domain and also for generating resource names. Defaults to a value prefixed with "aiovm-".
Type of authentication to use on the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
SSH key or password for the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
The size of the VM, at least 16GB RAM is required

variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

apt:
  preserve_sources_list: true
  sources:
    msft.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://packages.microsoft.com/ubuntu/24.04/prod noble main'
      keyid: BC528686B50D79E339D3721CEB3E94ADBE1229CF
    azurecli.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/azure-cli noble main'
      keyid: BC528686B50D79E339D3721CEB3E94ADBE1229CF
    kubernetes.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/ /'
      keyid: DE15B14486CD377B9E876E1A234654DA9A296436

packages:
  - bash
  - azure-cli
  - kubectl
  - git
  - moby-cli
  - moby-engine
  - wget
  - curl
  - coreutils
  - util-linux
  - gnupg

write_files:
  # 1. Initial MOTD (Comments Removed from content)
  - path: /etc/motd
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      |          Azure IoT Operations Dev VM Provisioning          |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      | Status: Starting Up...                                     |
      | Action: Running cloud-init setup script                    |
      |                                                            |
      | To monitor progress in real-time (from another terminal):  |
      | $ watch -n 1 -t cat /etc/motd                              |
      |                                                            |
      | Please wait for configuration to complete.                 |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+

  # 2. The main provisioning script
  - path: /root/provision_ops_vm.sh
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0700'
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail

      # --- Configuration ---
      TOTAL_STEPS=8
      MOTD_WIDTH=62

      # --- Helper Function: update_motd ---
      update_motd() {
          local step_num="$1"
          local status_msg="$2"
          shift 2
          local details=("$@")
          local text_width=$((MOTD_WIDTH - 4))

          printf '+%.0s' $(seq 1 $MOTD_WIDTH) > /etc/motd
          echo >> /etc/motd

          local step_info
          if [[ "$step_num" == "ERROR" || "$step_num" == "SUCCESS" ]]; then
              step_info="$status_msg"
          else
              step_info="Step $step_num of $TOTAL_STEPS: $status_msg"
          fi
          if [ ${#step_info} -gt $text_width ]; then
              step_info="$(echo "$step_info" | head -c $((text_width - 3)))..."
          fi
          local padding=$(( (text_width - ${#step_info}) / 2 ))
          local remainder=$(( (text_width - ${#step_info}) % 2 ))
          printf '| %*s%s%*s |\n' $padding "" "$step_info" $((padding + remainder)) "" >> /etc/motd

          if [ ${#details[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
               printf '|%.0s' $(seq 1 $((MOTD_WIDTH-2))) >> /etc/motd
               echo '|' >> /etc/motd
          fi
          for detail in "${details[@]}"; do
              local truncated_detail="$detail"
              if [ ${#truncated_detail} -gt $text_width ]; then
                  truncated_detail="$(echo "$truncated_detail" | head -c $((text_width - 3)))..."
              fi
              local detail_padding=$(( (text_width - ${#truncated_detail}) / 2 ))
              local detail_remainder=$(( (text_width - ${#truncated_detail}) % 2 ))
              printf '| %*s%s%*s |\n' $detail_padding "" "$truncated_detail" $((detail_padding + detail_remainder)) "" >> /etc/motd
          done

           if [ ${#details[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
               printf '|%*s|\n' $((MOTD_WIDTH-2)) "" >> /etc/motd
           fi

          printf '+%.0s' $(seq 1 $MOTD_WIDTH) >> /etc/motd
          echo >> /etc/motd
      }

      # --- Error Handling Function (Simplified) ---
      handle_error() {
          local exit_code=$?
          local line_no=${BASH_LINENO[0]:-unknown}

          update_motd "ERROR" "PROVISIONING FAILED!" \
              "Script: /root/provision_ops_vm.sh" \
              "Error on or near line: ${line_no}" \
              "Exit Code: ${exit_code}" \
              "Check cloud-init logs for details:" \
              "/var/log/cloud-init.log" \
              "/var/log/cloud-init-output.log"

          exit $exit_code
      }

      # --- Trap ERR signal ---
      trap handle_error ERR

      # --- Start Provisioning Steps ---
      update_motd "..." "Initializing Variables & Environment"
      export MYUSER=$(id -un 1000)
      export MYHOME=$(eval echo ~$MYUSER)
      export MYWORK="/workspaces"
      export LOCATION="${LOCATION:-{{{location}}}"
      export RESOURCE_GROUP="${RESOURCE_GROUP:-{{{resource_group}}}"
      export RESOURCE_NAME="${RESOURCE_NAME:-{{{resource_name}}}"

      if [[ "$LOCATION" == "{{{location}}}" || "$RESOURCE_GROUP" == "{{{resource_group}}}" || "$RESOURCE_NAME" == "{{{resource_name}}}" ]]; then
          update_motd "ERROR" "Missing Required Variables!" "Check cloud-init user-data."
          exit 1
      fi

      # -------------------------
      # Step 1 of 8: Install prerequisites.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Checking package tools..."
      SYSTEM_NAME=$(uname -r)

      if ! command -v k3d &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Downloading & Installing k3d..."
          wget -q -O - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k3d-io/k3d/main/install.sh | bash
      else
           update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "k3d already installed."
      fi


      if ! command -v helm &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Downloading & Installing Helm..."
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash
      else
           update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Helm already installed."
      fi

      if ! command -v step &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Downloading & Installing Step CLI..."
          STEP_VERSION="0.28.0"
          STEP_DEB="step-cli_${STEP_VERSION}_amd64.deb"
          STEP_TMP_DEB=$(mktemp --suffix=.deb)
          wget -qO "$STEP_TMP_DEB" "https://github.com/smallstep/cli/releases/download/v${STEP_VERSION}/${STEP_DEB}"
          dpkg -i "$STEP_TMP_DEB"
          rm "$STEP_TMP_DEB"
      else
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Step CLI already installed."
      fi

      update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Verifying Azure CLI..."
      if ! command -v az &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "ERROR" "Azure CLI Installation Failed!" "az command not found after package install."
          exit 1
      fi

      update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Installing AKS CLI components..."
      az aks install-cli --kubelogin-version 0.1.3 --aks-preview-cli-version 0.6.5 || echo "Warning: aks install-cli command finished with non-zero exit code."

      update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Adding/Updating Azure CLI extensions..."
      az extension add --upgrade --name azure-iot-ops &> /dev/null || echo "Warning: Failed to add or upgrade 'azure-iot-ops' extension."
      az extension add --upgrade --name connectedk8s &> /dev/null || echo "Warning: Failed to add or upgrade 'connectedk8s' extension."

      if ! command -v k9s &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Downloading & Installing k9s..."
          K9S_DEB_URL=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/derailed/k9s/releases/latest | grep 'browser_download_url.*linux_amd64.deb' | head -n 1 | cut -d '"' -f 4)
          if [[ -n "$K9S_DEB_URL" ]]; then
              K9S_TMP_DEB=$(mktemp --suffix=.deb)
              wget -qO "$K9S_TMP_DEB" "$K9S_DEB_URL"
              dpkg -i "$K9S_TMP_DEB"
              rm "$K9S_TMP_DEB"
          else
              update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "Warning: Could not determine k9s latest deb URL. Skipping."
          fi
      else
          update_motd "1" "Installing prerequisites" "k9s already installed."
      fi

      # -------------------------
      # Step 2 of 8: Create k3d cluster.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "2" "Creating k3d cluster" "Checking existing k3d cluster..."
      if k3d cluster list | grep -q '^k3s-default'; then
          update_motd "2" "Creating k3d cluster" "Deleting existing k3s-default cluster..."
          k3d cluster delete k3s-default || true
      fi


      update_motd "2" "Creating k3d cluster" "Creating new cluster 'k3s-default'..." "This may take a few minutes."
      k3d cluster create k3s-default \
        -p '1883:1883@loadbalancer' \
        -p '8883:8883@loadbalancer' \
        -p '8884:8884@loadbalancer' \
        --registry-create k3d-registry.localhost:127.0.0.1:5000 \
        --wait

      update_motd "2" "Creating k3d cluster" "Configuring kubectl context..."
      mkdir -p "$MYHOME/.kube"
      k3d kubeconfig merge k3s-default --kubeconfig-merge-default
      chown "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYHOME/.kube"
      chown "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYHOME/.kube/config"
      chmod 600 "$MYHOME/.kube/config"

      kubectl config use-context k3d-k3s-default
      kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=azure-iot-operations
      sudo -u "$MYUSER" KUBECONFIG="$MYHOME/.kube/config" kubectl config use-context k3d-k3s-default
      sudo -u "$MYUSER" KUBECONFIG="$MYHOME/.kube/config" kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=azure-iot-operations


      # -------------------------
      # Step 3 of 8: Arc-enable the Kubernetes cluster.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "3" "Azure Arc Connection" "Logging into Azure (Managed Identity)..."
      az login --identity --output none

      update_motd "3" "Azure Arc Connection" "Connecting cluster to Arc..." "Resource: $RESOURCE_NAME" "RG: $RESOURCE_GROUP" "Location: $LOCATION"
      az connectedk8s connect --name "$RESOURCE_NAME" --location "$LOCATION" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --correlation-id "" --output none

      # -------------------------
      # Step 4 of 8: Create Storage Account.
      # -------------------------
      UNIQUE_SUFFIX=$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | sha256sum | head -c 10)
      STORAGE_ACCOUNT="st$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$UNIQUE_SUFFIX"
      STORAGE_ACCOUNT=$(echo "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)


      update_motd "4" "Azure Storage Account" "Checking for account: $STORAGE_ACCOUNT"
      if az storage account show --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --output none &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "4" "Azure Storage Account" "Account $STORAGE_ACCOUNT already exists."
      else
          update_motd "4" "Azure Storage Account" "Creating account: $STORAGE_ACCOUNT..." "RG: $RESOURCE_GROUP" "Location: $LOCATION"
          az storage account create --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --location "$LOCATION" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --enable-hierarchical-namespace true --sku Standard_RAGRS --kind StorageV2 --output none
      fi

      update_motd "4" "Azure Storage Account" "Retrieving Resource ID..."
      SA_RESOURCE_ID=$(az storage account show --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)
      if [[ -z "$SA_RESOURCE_ID" ]]; then
          update_motd "ERROR" "Failed to get Storage Account ID!" "Account: $STORAGE_ACCOUNT"
          exit 1
      fi
      export SA_RESOURCE_ID

      # -------------------------
      # Step 5 of 8: Create Schema Registry.
      # -------------------------
      SR_SUFFIX_HASH=$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | sha256sum | head -c 10)
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY="sr$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$SR_SUFFIX_HASH"
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY=$(echo "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE="srn$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$SR_SUFFIX_HASH"
      SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)


      update_motd "5" "Azure Schema Registry" "Checking for registry: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY"
      if az iot ops schema registry show --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --output none &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "5" "Azure Schema Registry" "Registry $SCHEMA_REGISTRY already exists."
      else
          update_motd "5" "Azure Schema Registry" "Creating registry: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY..." "Namespace: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" "RG: $RESOURCE_GROUP"
          az iot ops schema registry create --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --registry-namespace "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" --sa-resource-id "$SA_RESOURCE_ID" --output none
      fi

      # -------------------------
      # Step 6 of 8: Initialize IoT Operations.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "6" "Azure IoT Operations Init" "Checking initialization status..." "Cluster: $RESOURCE_NAME"
      if ! kubectl get ns azure-iot-operations &> /dev/null || ! kubectl get deployment mq-operator -n azure-iot-operations &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "6" "Azure IoT Operations Init" "Running az iot ops init..." "Cluster: $RESOURCE_NAME" "RG: $RESOURCE_GROUP" "(Using --no-tls for k3d)"
          az iot ops init --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --no-tls --no-progress
      else
          update_motd "6" "Azure IoT Operations Init" "Already initialized." "Cluster: $RESOURCE_NAME"
      fi

      # -------------------------
      # Step 7 of 8: Create IoT Ops Instance.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "7" "Azure IoT Ops Instance" "Retrieving Schema Registry ID..."
      SR_RESOURCE_ID=$(az iot ops schema registry show --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)
      if [[ -z "$SR_RESOURCE_ID" ]]; then
        update_motd "ERROR" "Failed to get Schema Registry ID!" "Registry: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY"
        exit 1
      fi
      INSTANCE_NAME="${RESOURCE_NAME}-instance"

      update_motd "7" "Azure IoT Ops Instance" "Checking for instance: $INSTANCE_NAME"
      if ! kubectl get broker "$INSTANCE_NAME" -n azure-iot-operations &> /dev/null; then
          update_motd "7" "Azure IoT Ops Instance" "Creating instance: $INSTANCE_NAME..." "Cluster: $RESOURCE_NAME" "RG: $RESOURCE_GROUP" "(Low profile, RF=1)"
          az iot ops instance create \
              --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" \
              --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
              --name "$INSTANCE_NAME" \
              --sr-resource-id "$SR_RESOURCE_ID" \
              --broker-frontend-replicas 1 \
              --broker-frontend-workers 1 \
              --broker-backend-part 1 \
              --broker-backend-workers 1 \
              --broker-backend-rf 1 \
              --broker-mem-profile Low \
              --no-progress \
              --output none
      else
          update_motd "7" "Azure IoT Ops Instance" "Instance $INSTANCE_NAME already exists."
      fi

      # -------------------------
      # Step 8 of 8: Configure kube config and Finalize.
      # -------------------------
      update_motd "8" "Finalizing Setup" "Ensuring kubeconfig permissions..." "User: $MYUSER"
      chown "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYHOME/.kube/config"
      chmod 600 "$MYHOME/.kube/config"


      update_motd "8" "Finalizing Setup" "Setting workspace ownership..." "Path: $MYWORK"
      mkdir -p "$MYWORK"
      chown -R "$MYUSER":"$MYUSER" "$MYWORK"

      # -------------------------
      # Final Success Message
      # -------------------------
      trap - ERR

      update_motd "SUCCESS" "PROVISIONING COMPLETE!" \
          "System is ready." \
          "Kubeconfig set for user '$MYUSER'" \
          "Try: kubectl get pods -A" \
          "Try: k9s"

      echo "Script /root/provision_ops_vm.sh finished successfully."


runcmd:
  - /root/provision_ops_vm.sh
